Project Description
Hiredbuddy is seeking an entry-level Full Stack Developer to join our remote team. You'll build and maintain web applications, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and grow your skills in a supportive environment. If you're passionate about coding and ready to make an impact, apply today!
Full Description
As an Entry Level Full Stack Developer at Hiredbuddy, you will be an integral part of our engineering team, contributing to the design, development, and maintenance of web applications that serve a diverse client base. This remote role is perfect for someone who is eager to apply foundational coding skills in a real-world environment while learning from experienced professionals. You will work on both front-end and back-end components, ensuring seamless user experiences and robust server-side logic.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and maintain responsive web applications using modern JavaScript frameworks such as React or Vue.js for the front end.
Build and integrate RESTful APIs and microservices using Node.js, Express, or similar back-end technologies.
Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code that follows industry best practices.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including designers, product managers, and other developers to deliver high-quality features.
Participate in code reviews, provide constructive feedback, and continuously improve development processes.
Troubleshoot and debug applications to optimize performance and ensure reliability.
Work with databases (SQL or NoSQL) to design schemas, write queries, and manage data storage.
Use version control systems like Git for collaborative development and deployment.
Stay updated with emerging technologies and suggest improvements to existing systems.
Assist in testing and deployment using CI/CD pipelines and cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or Heroku).
Technologies and Tools
Our stack evolves, but currently we rely on:
Front-end: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), React, Redux, or Vue.js
Back-end: Node.js, Express, Python (Django/Flask) or Ruby on Rails
Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or MySQL
Version Control: Git, GitHub/GitLab
Deployment: Docker, AWS, Netlify, Vercel
Testing: Jest, Mocha, Chai, Cypress
Communication: Slack, Zoom, Jira, Trello
Growth and Development
At Hiredbuddy, we invest in our team's growth. You will receive direct mentorship from senior engineers, regular feedback, and access to resources that help you advance your skills. We encourage exploration of new tools and technologies, and we provide a clear path for progression to mid-level and senior roles. Your contributions will directly impact the success of our products and the satisfaction of our clients.
Work Environment
This is a fully remote position, allowing you to work from anywhere within the United States. We value work-life balance and flexibility, while maintaining a strong sense of community through virtual events, pair programming sessions, and open communication channels. You will have the support you need to succeed, whether it's through structured onboarding, regular check-ins, or a dedicated buddy system.
If you are ready to launch your career as a Full Stack Developer and make a meaningful impact, we would love to hear from you.
Requirements
0-2 years of experience in full stack development (internships and personal projects count)
Proficiency in at least one front-end framework (React, Vue, or Angular) and one back-end language (Node.js, Python, or Ruby)
Understanding of RESTful APIs and HTTP fundamentals
Familiarity with relational and/or NoSQL databases
Knowledge of version control systems (Git)
Ability to write clean, testable code
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
Excellent communication and teamwork abilities
Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote environment
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
Benefits
Competitive entry-level salary with performance reviews
100% remote work flexibility
Health, dental, and vision insurance
Paid time off and public holidays
Home office stipend
Access to learning platforms and certification courses
Mentorship from senior developers
Opportunity for career growth and role advancement

As an Associate Data Engineer, you will join an engineering team dedicated to building resilient, high-throughput data platforms, modern pipelines, and data mesh architectures using cloud-native tools. Cloud Architecture: Build, configure, and monitor data processing workloads using AWS native services (S3, EMR, Glue, Lambda, and Kinesis).
Data Modeling & Storage: Support relational, document, and columnar data warehousing solutions (PostgreSQL, Snowflake, and Redshift) with efficient schemas, partitioning, and indexing.
Data Quality & Governance: Implement automated data validation checks, monitoring, schema drift detection, and data lineage tracking to maintain high data reliability in a regulated financial environment.
DevOps & Automation: Adopt CI/CD practices (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Terraform) to deploy data infrastructure as code and schedule jobs via orchestrators like Apache Airflow.
Agile Collaboration: Participate in sprint ceremonies, peer code reviews, backlog grooming, and technical problem-solving sessions.

Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative STEM discipline (or equivalent practical technical training/bootcamp completion).
Programming: Academic, project, or internship experience coding in Python, SQL, Scala, or Java.
Database Fundamentals: Strong foundation in relational database management systems (RDBMS) and writing optimized SQL queries (joins, aggregations, window functions).
Work Authorization: Must possess valid, unrestricted U.S. work authorization. Capital One will sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this entry-level position (e.g., H-1B transfer or initial petition). Candidates holding permanent authorization (U.S. Citizen, Permanent Resident, Asylee/Refugee/OPT) or eligible status with current authorization to work for any employer are welcome to apply.
Required Skills
Academic, project, or internship experience coding in Python, SQL, Scala, or Java.
Strong foundation in relational database management systems (RDBMS) and writing optimized SQL queries (joins, aggregations, window functions).
Preferred Skills
Prior internship, capstone project, or open-source contribution in data engineering or cloud software development.
Familiarity with distributed computing engines such as Apache Spark or distributed messaging queues such as Apache Kafka.
Hands-on exposure to cloud environments, especially Amazon Web Services (AWS).
Knowledge of workflow orchestration tools like Apache Airflow.
Understanding of basic Git/GitHub version control workflows and automated testing practices.
Pay range and compensation package
Estimated Compensation & Benefits
Base Salary Range: $95,000 – $125,000 / year (commensurate with geographic location, education, and relevant experience).
Incentive Compensation: Discretionary year-end performance bonus and eligibility for 401(k) matching up to 7.5%.
Benefits: Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance; remote home office setup stipend; flexible paid time off (PTO); parental leave; and tuition assistance/learning stipends.

Capital One is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusivity in the workplace. title: Fullstack Software Engineer, ADK
description_preview:
About Pelico
Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.
We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones.
Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started.
This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.
About The Role
Companies have multiple founding moments and Pelico is going through a new one.
You would be one of the founding engineers of our new agentic platform, building alongside a small, super talented, high-bar team. This is a hands-on seat from day one: you write the code that manufacturers and their own AI teams build on, close to real customers and real factory data.
You benefit from company assets (data, events dependency graphs, simulation engine, next best action algorithms) and the reach that comes from Pelico running the operational data of multiple leading manufacturers.
What You'll Do
Ship agent capabilities end to end. Build real features from the tool/MCP and orchestration backend through to the React console, live for users - not demos.
Harden the runtime. Durable execution, retries, scheduling, and human-in-the-loop approvals on agent actions that carry real consequences.
Make agents trustworthy. Grow the eval harness (scenario evals, LLM-as-judge) so we catch regressions in agent behavior before they ship.
Build a console people believe. Real-time streaming of agent events, tool calls, and approvals - clear, fast, and reliable enough that a controller trusts it.
Set a craft bar. Write specs others build against, keep the frontend/backend contract honest, and leave reusable patterns the team adopts.
About You
We care about how good you are and how far you can go, and we calibrate to the experience you bring. This seat is built for exceptional people - whether you are just out of a top program or already have a few years of serious building behind you.
An excellent engineer who ships. You write excellent code and have built real things, full-stack across a Python backend and a React frontend - or you are clearly able to get there fast.
Hungry and driven. You want a hard problem to own, not a comfortable seat, and you have the ceiling to grow into far more.
Rigorous with non-deterministic systems. You spec and eval before shipping, trust evidence over vibes, and own what goes out - including AI-assisted code - following problems into production.
AI-native and curious. You understand how agent frameworks, tools, and evals actually work under the hood, and you build with AI coding tools every day.
Calm in fast-moving ambiguity. You stay effective on a stack where this quarter's best practice changes next quarter, turning uncertainty into a workable plan.
Nice to have: real AI/agent product experience (MCP, agent frameworks, evals); durable workflow engines (e.g. Temporal); streaming UIs; observability (OpenTelemetry); spec-driven development; multi-tenant SaaS, or aerospace/defense/discrete-manufacturing context.
Why Pelico
If You Want To Build Something Hard From The Ground Up, With Real Ownership From Day One, This Is The Seat. What Comes With It
A founding team and a real mandate. You help build Condor from its early days, with genuine ownership of what you ship and room to grow fast.
The highest-stakes work you could take on. You build for some of the largest manufacturers, at the scale of their global operations, on a moat competitors cannot copy: we own both the factory simulation and the scoreboard that says whether an agent actually helped.
A small, elite, AI-native team. Be challenged by strong peers, learn quickly, and ship fast.
Competitive salary benchmarked to your market, plus health, dental, and vision coverage and a learning budget.
Pelico is an equal opportunity employer. We're committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

The Software Engineer 2 plays a key role in developing and maintaining solutions that support secure and reliable file transfers between external partners and internal systems, with a strong emphasis on Hyland OnBase integrations and enterprise content management solutions.
You will be responsible for designing, configuring, and supporting integrations between Hyland OnBase, the organization's Record Management System, and web applications to enable efficient file upload and download capabilities, document management, and seamless business process automation.
You will bring experience in Hyland OnBase administration, configuration, and integration, along with strong technical skills in C#, .NET, HTML, CSS, SSIS, SQL, and related tools. You will also troubleshoot complex issues, gather and translate requirements, document technical solutions, and work collaboratively across teams to ensure secure, compliant, and reliable system performance.
Our Department of Defense Contract requires U.S. citizenship for this position.
This position may require associates to come into the office 1- 2 days per week. You will report to the Associate Director, HGB IT Platform and Foundational Services for Humana Military.
Required Qualifications
1 or more years' experience supporting or developing integrations with Hyland OnBase
Experience with enterprise content management, system configuration, and application interoperability
Proficiency in C#, .NET, SQL, SSIS, HTML, and CSS
Experience designing and implementing API integrations
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills
Strong verbal and written communication skills, including technical documentation
Successfully receive interim approval for government security clearance (NBIS– National Background Investigation Service)
Our Department of Defense contract requires U.S. citizenship for this position. We are not able to hire candidates that are living in Puerto Rico.
Preferred Qualifications
Use your skills to make an impact
Experience with OnBase Workflow, Unity Client, Unity APIs, document import processes, and document retrieval solutions
Experience integrating OnBase with web applications and record management platforms
Ability to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions
Familiarity with operational, compliance, and security standards in regulated environments
Experience supporting file upload/download solutions for internal and external business partners
Knowledge of software development lifecycle practices and change management processes
Experience working in a healthcare, government, or other highly regulated environment

In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.
Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

40
Pay Range
The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. Job Description
Job Title:
Software Engineer II
Location:
Raleigh, NC
Work Model:
Hybrid work model
Purpose And Objective
Elster Solutions LLC seeks a Software Engineer II at our Raleigh, NC location to steer end-to-end development using .NET Core, C#, Visual Basic, and Xamarin Forms, delivering scalable and maintainable software solutions.
For this application, it is required for you to fill the next skills assessment forms:
Software Engineer II –
Please ensure that you fill out this form as part of your application process.
Kindly note, only the applicants that fill out this form will be considered for the position.**
Responsibilities for External Candidates
Expectations And Tasks
Develop robust and scalable microservices and integrations based applications utilizing cloud-native architecture. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions. Adhere to code quality practices including SOLID principles, design patterns, and using static and dynamic code analysis tools such as Coverity and BlackDuckHub. Ensure all field released software products developments adhere to the Honeywell Security Development Lifecycle (SDLC). Implement enterprise-grade cybersecurity architectures aligned with NIST, ISO 27001, and OWASP standards. Conduct threat modeling using tools like Microsoft Threat Modeling Tool, OWASP Threat Dragon, or custom frameworks. Define security controls for mobile, web, and cloud-based applications. Lead vulnerability assessments, penetration testing coordination, and remediation planning. Build and maintain CI/CD pipeline that feature automation and configuration of management code to build scalable, reliable and secure systems. Observe compliance with privacy laws through assessment of personal data usage and adherence to export compliance rules via completion of Privacy Impact Assessments. Verify the functionality of components and services and ensures deployment meets expectations. Design, create, and document test plans, possibly code a custom test automation framework. Provision handheld devices and configure Bluetooth belt clip radios for customers. Provide technical consulting to internal and external customers to address system issues and recommend solutions.
Education And Occupational Experience
Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Communications Studies, or a related field of study and three (3) years of experience in the job offered or related occupation. Alternatively, a Master’s degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Communications Studies, or a related field of study.
Qualifications/Skills And Competencies Experience
Position requires academic or work experience involving each of the following:
Mobile app development frameworks;
Programming languages;
.Net Framework (VB.Net or C#);
SQL and relational databases;
Creating and managing APIs and microservices;
Version control;
CI/CD practices and tools (Jenkins and GitHub Actions);
Creating meaningful unit tests, with integration testing tools; and
Communicating with teams and customers about technical concepts.

$113,547 per year
Travel
N/A.

CRB is seeking a talented and motivated
Control System Developer
to join our growing team. In this role, you will be responsible for the programming, implementation, testing, and documentation of complex and technically sophisticated automated control systems. You will work collaboratively under the guidance of a Project Manager and potentially a Lead or Senior Control Systems Developer to deliver high-quality solutions for our clients.
This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in shaping the future of a rapidly growing and innovative business. .

Design, program, and implement automated control systems for a variety of industrial applications.
Configure, install, and troubleshoot PC/PLC hardware, software, and customer networks.
Support system installation and commissioning at client sites.
Provide in-house and on-site training for customer operators.
Maintain confidentiality of sensitive client information.
Deliver occasional after-hours support as needed.
Collaborate with engineers, designers, partners, and clients in a team-oriented environment.
Travel up to 35% for system installations and plant start-ups, including potential overnight shifts.
Maintain a regular in-office presence.
Qualifications
Associate degree in Computer Studies; Instrumentation and Controls; or equivalent combination of education and experience
Ability to multi-task and handle multiple concurrent projects
Passionate about problem solving and developing solutions
Proficiency in the Microsoft Office software suite required
Excellent organizational skills and mechanical inclination.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

description_preview:
Description
The Service Transformation and Deployment Automation team aims to remove all manual touchpoints from service operations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) Networking, one of the world’s largest and most complex networks. Systems Development Engineers are instrumental in discovering innovative ways to automate and scale services. They drive stability, consistency, and sustainability of the network while never losing sight of the high security bar our customer’s demand. We own a container compute platform in the border network, network device access and locality software, and a business intelligence platform for providing insights into service maturity. This position is located in Minneapolis, USA and working in the heart of AWS global network.
Millions of customers rely on Amazon’s network for using our retail websites, accessing content on their Kindles, and building applications and businesses on top of the Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud. Our goal is to become The Infrastructure Platform for the world – achieving this goal requires automated and massively scalable software services. Success depends on our world-class network infrastructure, and our network depends on our automation.
This position involves on-call responsibilities, typically for one week every two months. We don’t like getting paged in the middle of the night or on the weekend, so we work to ensure that our systems are fault tolerant. When we do get paged, we work together to resolve the root cause so that we don’t get paged for the same issue twice.
Our team is dedicated to supporting new team members. Our team has a broad mix of experience levels and Amazon tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Our senior engineers truly enjoy mentoring more junior engineers and engineers from non-traditional backgrounds through one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth. We try to assign projects and tasks based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded engineer and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.
We’re looking for a new teammate who is enthusiastic, empathetic, curious, motivated, reliable, and able to work effectively with a diverse team of peers; someone who will help us amplify the positive & inclusive team culture we’ve been building.
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empowers us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. We not only celebrate the diversity of our workforce, we celebrate the diverse ways we work. If you would like to request an accommodation for the interview or onboarding process, please let us know and we will connect you to our accommodation team. You may also reach them directly by visiting https://www.amazon.jobs/en/disability/us.
Mentorship and Career growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Key job responsibilities
You will be responsible for the design, implementation and quality of services you deliver. Your experience working in a systems development or in an enterprise environment will help us implement automated solutions across a variety of applications and systems.
You’ll Also
Design, implement, test, deploy and maintain innovative solutions to transform service performance, durability, cost, and security.
Write high quality distributed system software.
Work in an agile, startup-like development environment, where you are always working on the most important stuff.
Work closely with our Network/Systems/Software Engineering teams to ensure fast and smooth roll-out of new designs and products, as well as assist with deployment and sustaining of networking software tools.
Use data to measure success and take responsibility for the quality of your service and, regardless of their source, strive to prevent faults from impacting your customers.
Use your strong problem-solving skills, ability to understand and scope solutions, work across teams to drive solutions.
Contribute to documentation of process and procedures.
Learn from others and help grow those in your team to achieve their best.
Take ownership, consider tradeoffs and lean on your expertise to ensure the job gets done.
Participate in an on-call rotation with your team.

title: Engineer I - Embedded Software Engineer (Engineering Development Program 2027)
description_preview:
Who We Are
Vermeer equips customers doing important work around the world. We are global, driven by innovation and growing. The equipment we make manages natural resources, connects people and feeds and fuels communities. We live out a caring culture, we demonstrate agility, we keep a focus on customers and are stewards of our resources. These beliefs drive our culture, determine how we treat others and steer our business.
Job Summary
Are you passionate about developing intelligent control systems that drive innovation across real-world equipment platforms? In this role, you will help design and implement embedded software solutions that power Vermeer’s next-generation machinery, used in industries like agriculture, construction, utilities, and more. You’ll work alongside a collaborative team to build innovative, reliable, and efficient systems that help shape the next generation of intelligent, automated off-highway equipment.
What You’ll Do
Design, develop, and test embedded software using C, C++, and MATLAB/Simulink for real-time control systems.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate stakeholder needs into technical requirements and implement solutions that align with Vermeer’s innovation goals.
Develop and refine Human-Machine Interfaces (HMI) and user experiences for embedded control systems.
Integrate and validate control systems using CAN protocols (e.g., SAE J1939) and serial communication standards.
Support rapid prototyping and iterative development using Agile methodologies and DevOps practices such as Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) and version control (Git, GitHub).
Contribute to safety-critical system development with awareness of functional safety standards like International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 26262 or International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC) 61508.
What We’re Looking For
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Agricultural Engineering, or related field with an emphasis in embedded systems, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience or coursework in embedded programming using tools such as C, C++, and MATLAB/Simulink.
Interest or experience in robotics, machine automation, DevOps practices (CI/CD), or version control systems (Git, GitHub).
Understanding of control system theory, including electrical and electro-hydraulic control architectures.
Experience with HMI development or User Interface/User Experience (UI/UX) design for embedded systems.
Familiarity with Controller Area Network (CAN) protocols (e.g., SAE J1939), serial communication standards, and Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) such as FreeRTOS or VxWorks.
Awareness of Agile software development methodologies and functional safety standards such as ISO 26262 or IEC 61508.
Knowledge of PLM and Engineering Change Notification (ECN) systems like Dassault Systems 3DX or equivalent.
Demonstrated willingness to perform hands-on troubleshooting, testing, and analysis on physical equipment in lab or field environments.
Travel
Occasional travel is expected of this position.
Work Location
HYBRID: Some of a team member’s day-to-day work may be best done at a location other than a Vermeer campus. Discuss specific arrangements with your manager.
Equal Opportunity Employer
At Vermeer Corporation, we believe in the value of your unique identity, background, and experiences. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status or any other status protected by the law. Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation due to a disability at any stage of the employment application process should contact Team Member Solutions at (641) 621-8767 or at hr@vermeer.com.
Interested? We’d love to get to know you.

description_preview:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
Your impact
We're looking for a
Forward Deployed Engineer
(FDE I) to build alongside more experienced FDEs, Implementation Leads, and Architects, executing well-defined requirements across Foundry and custom applications. You'll work across multiple active projects, learning to move between domains quickly — with guidance close at hand when requirements are unclear or you're in unfamiliar territory. This isn't a role where you get one project and go deep for a year; you'll be building real range early in your career, with support built into how the work is structured.
This role doesn't carry people leadership responsibility. What it does require is a strong technical foundation, genuine curiosity across both
Foundry and custom development
, and the ability to stay productive and ask good questions in a fast-paced, sometimes ambiguous environment.
Compensation
This role is open to Entry level, Intermediate and Associate levels so final pay will be based on experience level
What You'll Do
Build, Forward Deployed — Work embedded with client and project teams to build and configure Foundry-based and custom software features in response to defined requirements
Execute Well-Defined Work — Take clear direction from the Senior AI Solutions Architect or a Mid–Senior FDE and turn it into working code, Ontology objects, pipelines, or integrations — asking good questions when something's unclear rather than guessing
Support Multiple Projects — Carry a workload across more than one project, learning to prioritize and context-switch between codebases and problem domains without dropping quality
Ask for Direction — Recognize when you're facing ambiguity or unfamiliar territory and proactively seek guidance rather than stalling or guessing
Follow Portfolio Standards — Build to the patterns and standards set by more senior FDEs and the architect, so your work fits cleanly into the broader DPS portfolio
Debug & Support — Troubleshoot issues in features you've built, respond to feedback, and support existing applications alongside new work
Build Range — Grow your skills across both Palantir Foundry and custom development, with support from senior team members as you branch into less familiar areas
Collaborate Cross-Functionally — Work alongside project managers, other developers, and subject matter experts as an active contributor, present in client sessions and supporting the technical conversation.
Here's what you'll need
Must-haves
0–5 years of relevant experience — strong fundamentals and a genuine eagerness to build range across stacks
Foundational experience with Palantir Foundry (Ontology, pipelines, applications) or demonstrated ability to ramp up quickly; AIP/OSDK exposure a plus
Software development experience, including a modern JavaScript frontend framework (React preferred) and/or Python
Comfort working across multiple projects — able to balance competing priorities with support from the team
A fast-paced, client-facing mindset — comfortable with shifting requirements and being embedded with the people using what you build.
Strongly Preferred
Exposure to REST APIs and relational or cloud-native data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB, MongoDB)
Interest in AI/LLM-enabled features and using AI tools to accelerate your own development work
Working knowledge of Agile delivery, Git, and CI/CD practices
Prior internship, co-op, or early-career experience in a professional services, consulting, or client-facing environment
Education/Certifications — A relevant college degree and/or willingness to pursue certifications (e.g., Palantir Foundry certifications, cloud platform certifications) — equivalent hands-on experience valued just as highly.
Location
Hybrid in the United States, with occasional travel for project and client meetings, primarily in North America.
A list of offices can be found here https//www.jacobs.com/locations/americas/united-states
Our health and welfare benefits are designed to invest in you, and in the things you care about. Your health. Your well-being. Your security. Your future. Employees have access to medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance, a 401(k) plan, and the ability to purchase company stock at a discount. Eligible employees may also enroll in a deferred compensation plan or the Executive Deferral Plan. Jacobs has an unlimited U.S. Personalized Paid Time Off (PPTO) policy for full-time salaried/exempt employees, seven paid holidays, and caregiver leave. And certain roles may be eligible for additional rewards, including merit increases, performance discretionary bonus, and stock.
The base salary range for this position is $80,000.00 to $110,000.00. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. Job posted on September 22, 2026. This position will be open for at least 3 days.

title: Software Engineer
description_preview:
Software Engineer
Location: Austin, Texas, United States
Industry: IT Services and IT Consulting
Work Setting: Remote
Are you passionate about building scalable software systems, solving complex technical challenges, and developing high-quality applications that power modern cloud-based platforms?
We are seeking a Software Engineer to design, develop, test, and support software applications and system-level solutions within a highly collaborative engineering environment. This role will contribute to application development, automation, cloud-based services, and platform enhancements while driving software quality, performance, and scalability.
Key Responsibilities
Software Development & Engineering
Design, develop, troubleshoot, test, and maintain software applications and system components.
Implement new features, enhancements, and functionality within existing software architectures.
Write clean, efficient, maintainable, and well-documented code following engineering best practices.
Participate in all phases of the software development lifecycle, from design through deployment and support.
Analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into scalable software solutions.
System Design & Architecture
Contribute to software architecture decisions and recommend improvements that enhance scalability, reliability, and maintainability.
Apply object-oriented design principles and software engineering best practices to develop robust applications.
Support the evolution of platform architecture by identifying opportunities for optimization and modernization.
Evaluate technical tradeoffs and recommend solutions that align with performance, reliability, and business requirements.
Testing & Quality Assurance
Develop and execute unit, integration, and automated tests to ensure software quality.

Opentrons Labworks, Inc. is a disruptive life science company leveraging its integrated lab platform to supercharge the pace of innovation in research and healthcare. Our robotic platform, API, and the apps built on top of them empower scientists to discover, build, and run their own automated experiments. The engineering team is constantly building, iterating on, and shipping these powerful and user friendly products. We are looking for a skilled Front End Software Engineer (SWE II) who can grow with the organization as a core member of the software team, and write applications in a way that is focused on customer needs and strikes a healthy balance of flexibility without unnecessary complexity.

description_preview:
Eaton’s Electrical Critical Power Solutions Division is seeking a Embedded Firmware & FPGA Engineer to join our innovative engineering team in Youngsville, NC. In this role, you will contribute to the architecture, design, development, verification, and release of FPGA-based solutions supporting next-generation power management products. Working alongside global, cross-functional teams, you will play a key role in bringing new products to market, including advanced silicon carbide (SiC)-based three-phase power conversion systems that deliver reliable power for mission-critical applications such as data centers.
The expected annual salary range for this role is $80000 - $118000 a year.
Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.
What You’ll Do
Work as part of an engineering team to architect, develop, verify, test, and release FPGA-based designs in support of new product development. Collaborate with global cross-functional teams to support the launch of new products, including SiC-based three-phase power conversion systems designed to support critical loads such as data centers.
Review product requirements and collaborate with systems, firmware, controls, power electronics, and hardware engineers to translate system-level specifications into FPGA architecture and detailed design requirements.
Evaluate alternative FPGA architectures and implementation approaches to meet customer and product development requirements while considering performance, resource utilization, cost, reliability, and schedule.
Design, develop, review, and maintain synthesizable RTL using Verilog, SystemVerilog, and/or VHDL.
Develop FPGA logic for functions such as PWM generation, digital control, protection and fault management, high-speed data acquisition, sequencing, state machines, digital filtering, and processor/peripheral interfaces.
Develop modular and reusable FPGA design components and establish effective FPGA coding and design practices.
Develop testbenches and perform RTL simulation and functional verification to ensure designs meet functional and system requirements.
Perform synthesis, place-and-route, static timing analysis, and timing closure using industry-standard FPGA development toolchains.
Analyze and resolve FPGA implementation challenges related to timing, resource utilization, clock distribution, reset architecture, and clock-domain crossing.
Design and integrate communication interfaces between FPGAs, microcontrollers, DSPs, ADCs, DACs, and other system components using interfaces such as SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, Ethernet, and parallel interfaces, as applicable.
Support board-level bring-up, integration, and debugging of FPGA-based systems using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, JTAG debuggers, and embedded FPGA debugging tools.
Participate in design reviews, RTL code reviews, verification reviews, and root-cause investigations.
Qualifications
Required (Basic) Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related engineering discipline from an accredited institution with at least 1 internship experience in embedded software or firmware development.
Preferred Qualifications
Professional experience developing synthesizable RTL using VHDL, Verilog, and/or SystemVerilog.
Experience with FPGA design workflows including RTL development, simulation, synthesis, implementation, timing analysis, and hardware validation.
Design experience with power electronic, industrial control, energy conversion, or other real-time embedded products.
Experience implementing digital control algorithms, PWM generation, modulation techniques and high-speed deterministic control functions in FPGA.
Experience with FPGA development toolchains such as Intel Quartus, and ModelSim/Questa.
Experience integrating FPGA designs with microcontrollers, DSPs, ADCs, DACs, and mixed-signal embedded systems.
Experience implementing communication interfaces such as SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, Ethernet, and high-speed serial or parallel interfaces.
Experience with embedded firmware development and programming in C/C++.
Experience using hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) simulation for system integration and validation.
Skills
Strong knowledge of digital logic design, synchronous design principles, finite-state machines, pipelining, clocking, reset architectures, and FPGA resource optimization.
Understanding of three-phase electrical power systems and power conversion concepts is preferred.
Ability to read and understand electrical schematics, component datasheets, interface specifications, and timing diagrams.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to work effectively in cross-functional and geographically distributed engineering teams.
Self-motivated, proactive, detail-oriented, and capable of independently driving technical activities to meet project schedules.
Ability to work in a laboratory environment around high-voltage equipment where strict adherence to safety practices is critical.

The Role
You will build and operate components of our data platform: the pipelines that move healthcare data from customer EHR systems into Snowflake, and the models that turn that raw data into trusted core entities. You will work within workstreams scoped and architected with senior engineers on the team, and own your components end to end - building them, testing them, running them in production, and fixing them when they break.
This is a growth role. You will get direct exposure to enterprise-scale healthcare data problems, a modern stack (Snowflake, SQLMesh, Temporal, Python, AWS, Datadog), and senior engineers invested in ramping you. The expectation is a steep trajectory: components today, workstreams as you grow.
What You Will Do
Build and maintain pipeline components within larger workstreams, with architecture guidance from senior engineers.
Write production Python and SQL: extract logic, transformations, and data quality checks.
Contribute to our core entity models and learn the RCM domain that drives them.
Debug data quality and pipeline issues through to root cause, not just symptom.
Run what you build. You join the on-call rotation with support from senior engineers.
Develop AI-natively. AI coding tools (Claude Code and similar) are part of how this team designs, builds, and reviews.
What You Will Bring
2+ years of software or data engineering experience with production code you can walk through in detail.
Solid Python and SQL fundamentals. You may not have deep warehouse experience yet, but you understand how data moves through a system.
Exposure to at least one part of the modern data stack: a cloud warehouse, an orchestration tool, or a transformation framework.
Strong debugging instincts and honesty about what you know versus what you are guessing.
You respond well to feedback and probing - depth may still be developing, but the fundamentals and the trajectory are visible.
Interest in healthcare data. You do not need domain experience, but you need the appetite for a messy, regulated domain.
The base salary range for this position is $165,000 to $190,000. Base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to base salary, we offer an annual bonus program, company equity, and a competitive benefits package.
About Adonis
Adonis is the leading AI orchestration platform for healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM), purpose-built for healthcare organizations seeking to transform their revenue operations. Traditional RCM processes often struggle with inefficiencies, costing providers up to 15% or more of their potential revenue. Through advanced automation, data science, and AI Agents, Adonis helps revenue teams detect vulnerabilities, optimize workflows, and deploy precise solutions that drive reliable and scalable financial outcomes.
Adonis is headquartered in New York City and has raised over $95M in funding, including a recent $40M Series C round led by Quadrille Capital with continued support from existing investors such as General Catalyst and Bling Capital. This funding supports our mission to restore sanity to RCM and equip provider groups and health systems with AI-driven revenue cycle operations at scale.
Compensation Philosophy
Actual base pay will depend on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Adonis determines compensation based on each candidate’s experience and qualifications relative to peers, and most new hires fall near the middle of the range. In addition to base salary, you’ll receive meaningful equity and great benefits.

Who We Are
Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.
What We Offer
Salary:
$161,000.00 - $221,000.00
Location:
Santa Clara,CA
You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.
At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
About Rocket
Rocket is a team within Applied dedicated to advancing and scaling rapid innovation methodologies across the organization. We focus on accelerating breakthrough technologies by combining deep scientific expertise, advanced computational methods, and practical engineering to solve complex challenges in semiconductor manufacturing.
Position Summary
We are seeking a highly motivated and intellectually curious
Algorithm Developer
to work at the intersection of
artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML), theoretical physics, and systems engineering
. In this role, you will drive the development of next-generation solutions for high-impact semiconductor manufacturing applications.
The successful candidate will contribute to multiple disruptive design initiatives by developing automated systems capable of ingesting and processing data from thousands of sensors, identifying critical physics-based relationships, and building predictive and control models. These solutions will leverage a hybrid approach that combines first-principles physics modeling with advanced machine learning techniques, including physics-informed neural networks (PINNs), to optimize complex manufacturing processes in real time.
Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Please apply by October 23rd, 2026. Note: This position may close early based on application volume or candidate selection.
Key Responsibilities
Design and develop scalable data pipelines to collect, process, and analyze high-volume sensor data from semiconductor manufacturing systems.
Identify and model underlying physical relationships governing complex process behavior.
Develop predictive and control algorithms using a combination of traditional physics-based methods and machine learning approaches.
Build robust, maintainable software modules that integrate directly with real-world manufacturing tools and systems.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams spanning physics, engineering, software development, and data science to accelerate innovation and technology deployment.
Contribute to the design and implementation of intelligent automation solutions for advanced semiconductor manufacturing processes.
Develop ML surrogates or reduced order models, based on rigorous physics simulations, including research, design, development and implementation & proliferation accompanying in accordance with project budgets and time schedules.
Optimize accuracy / performance tradeoffs, to retain achieve but speed execution of algorithm modules
Analyze large quantities of sensor and metrology data, and iteratively improve simulation and models to improve accuracy
Implement models and code for user facing applications, in control systems or dashboards
Maintain a clean and consistent code base, that can be extended by team
Ideal Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate possesses a strong foundation in theoretical and computational disciplines, coupled with practical software development expertise. You are passionate about applying scientific principles to solve real-world engineering challenges and are equally comfortable moving between mathematical modeling, machine learning, and software implementation.
You should demonstrate:
Deep expertise in one or more areas of theoretical physics, applied mathematics, computational science, or simulation-driven engineering.
Working knowledge of modern machine learning, data science, and statistical modeling techniques.
Strong software engineering capabilities, including the ability to translate complex algorithms into clean, scalable, and production-ready code.
A practical mindset focused on delivering solutions that interact with and control physical systems in real-world environments.
Qualifications

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.

Why Join Rincon Research Corporation (RRC)?
At Rincon Research Corporation, our primary business is innovating, developing, and fielding digital signal processing (DSP) products and services for the United States Defense and Intelligence Communities in support of national security.
Rincon Research Corporation (RRC), an employee owned company, is seeking a talented, tenacious, results-driven individualto work in a multi-disciplinary R&D environment with similarly motivated electrical engineers, mathematicians, computer scientists, and analysts who are collectively responsible for creating custom digital signal processing solutions and leveraging them to make an operational mission impact.
Come join the team that is creating cutting edge signal processing and geolocation systems for the future!
What are the primary responsibilities in the Multi-Discipline Engineer position?
This role offers the opportunity to work across the full engineering lifecycle, from early concept and architecture through implementation, integration, testing, and field deployment. Engineers in this role work on real systems—not just components—and see their work deployed in operational environments.
You will work across a wide range of technologies and platforms including:
Embedded systems
FPGA and firmware development
CPU/GPU architectures
RF and antenna systems
Digital signal processing solutions
Fully integrated hardware/software systems
This position offers the opportunity to contribute to innovative, mission-focused engineering solutions while collaborating with a team of talented engineers across multiple disciplines.
Key responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
Design and develop integrated hardware and software systems, including embedded firmware and digital signal processing solutions.
Participate in system architecture, requirements development, and interface design.
Implement and integrate solutions across embedded processors, FPGA platforms, and RF systems.
Develop and execute test plans and validation procedures to ensure performance and reliability.
Collaborate with cross-disciplinary teams to deliver high-performance mission systems.
Document system designs, performance analyses, and test results.
Contribute to innovation, prototyping, and new product development initiatives.
What required background will make you successful?
BS or MS in Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, or related field
Experience with one or more of the following: C, C++, Assembly, VHDL, or Verilog
Familiarity with microprocessors, microcontrollers, SoCs, and/or FPGA-based system design
Understanding of hardware and software design principles and industry best practices
Strong written and verbal communication skills for documenting and presenting technical work
Ability to quickly learn and navigate complex codebases and system architectures

Background in digital signal processing or communications systems
Experience with PCB layout and schematic capture

Experience with field testing of integrated hardware/software systems

This position can be located at our Centennial, CO location.
The likely salary range for this position is $110,000 to $136,000. This is not, however, a guarantee of compensation or salary. Rather, salary will be set based on experience, geographic location and possibly contractual requirements and could fall outside of this range.
